clue.text: Tone of musical instrument lacks finish

indicators.note: the word for the instrument is missing its final letter, its finish

parts.note: a harmonica is a mouth organ, a musical instrument

explanation.surface: The sound of some instrument is incomplete, as if the player stopped before the end.
explanation.definitionFit: In acoustics an overtone sounding above the fundamental is called by this name, so it is a kind of tone.

clue.text: Something abhorrent in four articles written about miners' leader

indicators.note: written about means the articles are set round another letter

parts.note: an, a, the and a are four articles of grammar

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of miners'

explanation.surface: A loathsome thing appears in several pieces written on a mining union boss.
explanation.walkthrough: The four articles AN, A, THE, A go round M, first of 'miners''.
explanation.definitionFit: Anathema is a thing or person intensely detested, a curse.

clue.text: Head, director's 'announcement of rating loss?

definitions.meaning: the chair, a man set above the board of directors
a rating is a sailor, and the cry goes up when one falls into the sea

explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, the phrase describes a chief placed over a company board; as a cry it alerts a ship that a sailor has fallen into the sea.

clue.text: Pointed articles leading to Sunday opening being unnecessary

parts.note: needles are sharp-pointed articles

indicators.note: opening means the first letter of Sunday

explanation.surface: Sharp objects brought out for Sunday's start seem superfluous.
explanation.definitionFit: Needless describes what is uncalled for or unnecessary.

clue.text: Primitive fellow gives up short holiday-a mean sort

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: vac is short for vacation, a holiday

indicators.note: sort means the letters of mean are arranged anew

explanation.surface: A crude man abandons a brief break, being a stingy type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns VAC to CAV; 'sort' rearranges MEAN to EMAN. 'gives' and 'a' only link.
explanation.definitionFit: A caveman is a prehistoric cave dweller, or figuratively a crude, primitive man.

clue.text: Amorous rite, nothing unusual to many

indicators.note: unusual means the letters are arranged in an odd order

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many

explanation.surface: A love ritual seems nothing out of the ordinary to lots of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges RITE plus O into EROTI.
explanation.definitionFit: Erotic means arousing sexual desire, relating to passionate love.

clue.text: Learned letters, say ?

indicators.note: say signals that the letters are pronounced, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: the letter Y in plural, two of them

explanation.surface: Educated correspondence, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: Wise means having knowledge and good judgement, learned.

clue.text: Are they filling in time after oral examination?

definitions.text: Are they filling in time after oral examination?

parts.words: Are they filling in time after oral examination?
parts.note: filling is putting fillings in teeth after inspecting the mouth, not wasting time after a viva

explanation.definitionFit: These professionals examine the mouth and then fill cavities in teeth.

clue.text: Poison obtained from a sort of taro tree

indicators.note: a sort of taro is a rearranged version of that word's letters

parts.note: a pine is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: A toxin is extracted from some kind of taro tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges TARO to ATRO; 'obtained from a' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Atropine is a toxic alkaloid from deadly nightshade, a poison used medically in small doses.

clue.text: Linen with borders round it ?:

definitions.meaning: a fine sheer linen fabric bears this name
a grassy garden plot typically edged with flower borders

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a fine plain-woven linen cloth; the other is a mown grass area in a garden, edged by flower beds.

clue.text: Most talented translation of portion of Scripture

indicators.note: translation here means the letters are carried over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A gifted translator renders part of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hebrew scriptures form the first part of the Christian Bible.

clue.text: Natural 'inclination to put a horse in a fresh team

parts.note: a mount is a horse for riding
a side is a team, here newly picked

explanation.surface: A tendency to add a horse to a new team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natural inclination' looks like a tendency; it is a slope in nature.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountainside is a natural slope, an inclination of the land.

clue.text: Withdraw view about the month's return

indicators.note: about means one word goes round another

parts.note: to see is to view

indicators.note: return means the month's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December, the month in question

explanation.surface: Someone pulls out after considering the month's results coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the month' is taken as the last month of the year, abbreviated; 'return' reverses it and 'about' wraps the view round it.
explanation.definitionFit: To secede is to formally withdraw from a union or federation.

clue.text: Reports scores, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a score was once a tally of money owed, a bill

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both narrative descriptions and financial records or bills, of which old scores (tallies) are examples.

clue.text: Cast includes doctor and one exchange expert

indicators.note: includes means the word cast holds the other letters within it

parts.note: taken as written
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: The line-up of actors features a medic and one financier.
explanation.definitionFit: A cambist is a dealer in bills of exchange, an expert on currency exchange.

clue.text: Waits for him and his companions

definitions.text: Waits for him and his companions

parts.words: Waits for him and his companions
parts.note: waits are groups of street singers at Christmas, not the act of waiting for someone

explanation.definitionFit: Christmas waits were bands of singers going house to house, each a singer of seasonal songs.

clue.text: Good-for-nothings, used to be given rest with change

parts.note: was is the past tense of be

indicators.note: with change means the letters of rest are altered in order

explanation.surface: Idlers who once worked are given a break for a change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with change' rearranges REST to TERS; 'given' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Wasters are idle, worthless people, layabouts.

clue.text: Sort of bed and board offering?

definitions.meaning: a bed made as a prank with a sheet folded so one cannot stretch out
a dish served at table, board meaning a table of food

explanation.definitionFit: An apple-pie bed is a practical-joke bed; an apple pie is a dessert served at the board or table.

clue.text: Hunter set out with one to a European region

indicators.note: set out means the letters of hunter are laid out afresh

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A huntsman sets off with a companion for a part of Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruthenia is a historical region of central-eastern Europe, roughly Carpathian Ukraine.

clue.text: Author in Jane Austen's family, so to speak.?

indicators.note: so to speak means the family name is pronounced, giving a writer's surname

parts.note: the Bennets are the family in Pride and Prejudice

explanation.surface: A writer belonging to the household of a famous novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnold Bennett was an English novelist, author of The Old Wives' Tale.

clue.text: Witty retort about some duplicate key

parts.note: re means about or concerning
part means some, a portion

indicators.note: duplicate means the key letter is written twice

parts.note: E is a musical key

explanation.surface: A clever comeback about part of a spare key.
explanation.definitionFit: Repartee is quick, witty conversation or a clever reply.

clue.text: Charge for some drawing?

parts.note: drawing means pulling a vehicle along, not sketching, and the charge is the fee for it

explanation.definitionFit: Towage is the fee paid for having a vessel or vehicle towed.

clue.text: Indicates the vessels in the centre :

indicators.note: the centre says the word in is placed at the middle of the vessels

parts.note: pots are vessels

explanation.surface: Someone directs attention to the containers in the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To indicate something is to show or direct attention towards it with a finger.

clue.text: Do they sound like malingerers ?.

parts.note: sailors sounding depth by swinging a lead weight share their name with shirkers who feign illness

explanation.definitionFit: Malingerers are idlers who shirk work, and in old naval slang a man swinging the sounding lead was said to be dodging duty.

clue.text: Take off ten from' the top

parts.note: to ape is to mimic, take off
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Remove ten from the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: The apex is the highest point, the summit or tip.

clue.text: They're charged for the portions left out

indicators.note: out means the word for left is removed from portions

parts.note: taken as written
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: People pay for helpings that were left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests paying a fee; it means carrying an electric charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Ions are atoms or molecules carrying an electric charge.

clue.text: Means to see a number about agreement

indicators.note: about means the number goes round the word of agreement

parts.note: eight is a number
yes expresses agreement

explanation.surface: A way of observing a number concerning a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyesight is the faculty of vision, the means by which we see.

clue.text: Great disturbance. about danger signal in' a Gwent town

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the signal
disturbance means the letters of great are stirred up

parts.note: a red light or flag is a danger signal

explanation.surface: Major unrest over a warning in a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbance' rearranges GREAT to TEGAR, which goes 'about' RED. Gwent is a former county in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Tredegar is an industrial town in south Wales, in the old county of Gwent.
